dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Cowboys (5-6) Week 12 Briefing: Friday Injury Report Ahead of Eagles
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: Dallas opened CB Devin Moore's 21-day IR practice window alongside limited work for S P.J. Locke (concussion). TE Jake Ferguson (knee / ankle), G Tyler Booker (ankle), and WR Jonathan Mingo (ankle) did not practice Friday, while S Jalen Thompson (hamstring) and QB Dak Prescott (left hand) practiced in full [Patrik Walker](https://x.com/VoiceOfTheStar/status/2125665032646091241).

Week 12 Eagles Outlook: Brian Schottenheimer and DC Christian Parker open installation for the Philadelphia Eagles (3-7, DAL -8.5, HC Nick Sirianni, OC Sean Mannion & DC Vic Fangio (AT&T Stadium))—a unit ranked #5 in Punt Return Average (12.0 yds) as Dallas prepares for a pivotal NFC matchup [Dan Rogers](https://www.bloggingtheboys.com/dallas-cowboys-analysis/227980/eagles-thanksgiving-joe-milton-dak-prescott-saquon-barkley) [Pro Football Focus](https://www.pff.com/news/the-10-best-nfl-player-matchups-to-watch-in-week-12-2/).

NFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 5-6 (2nd in NFC East • #10 Seed in NFC), Dallas carries a 16.9% postseason projection, 15.3% NFC East division title mark, and 0% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/preview?gameId=401873080).
Around the Beat: RT @PFF_Fantasy: Have yourself a mocktail and a MOCK DRAFT [PFF](https://x.com/PFF/status/2125993634814194060).

Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, Dallas ranks #3 in Points / Game (30.6), #29 in Points Allowed / Game (28.4), #22 in Turnover Differential (-2), giving Brian Schottenheimer and Christian Parker a clear benchmark ahead of Thu, Nov 26, 3:30 PM CST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the Philadelphia Eagles [Brian Martin](https://www.bloggingtheboys.com/dallas-cowboys-analysis/227927/eagles-matchups-saquon-barkley-quinnen-williams-dak-prescott).
